subject: gk
question: In the Union Budget 2025-26, there has been a plan establish _________- Day Care Cancer Centres in 2025-26.
solution:
The correct answer is __**200**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Union Budget 2025-26:** The Union Budget for the fiscal year **2025-26** has proposed the establishment of **200 Day Care Cancer Centres** to improve healthcare infrastructure and provide specialized treatment facilities for cancer patients. 
• **Day Care Cancer Centres:** These centres aim to deliver accessible and affordable cancer treatment, particularly for patients requiring chemotherapy or other day procedures, reducing the burden on larger hospitals. 
• **Healthcare Accessibility:** The move focuses on decentralizing cancer treatment, ensuring that patients in remote and underserved areas can access essential healthcare services without traveling long distances. 
• **Collaborative Efforts:** The initiative is likely to involve collaboration between the government and private entities, ensuring high-quality services and efficient operations. 
• **Cancer Statistics in India:** According to recent data, India reports nearly **14 lakh new cancer cases annually**. The establishment of Day Care Cancer Centres is a significant step toward addressing this growing health challenge. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Importance of Day Care Centres:** 
• Day Care Centres provide treatments such as **chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and minor surgical interventions** without requiring overnight hospital stays. 
• They help in reducing **hospital congestion** and improving patient convenience. 
• **Government Initiatives for Cancer Care:** 
• The Indian government has launched schemes like the **Ayushman Bharat**, which covers a range of treatments, including cancer care, for economically weaker sections. 
• It has also emphasized the need for early detection and preventive measures through public awareness campaigns. 
• **Challenges in Cancer Care:** 
• India faces challenges such as **limited infrastructure, shortage of oncologists**, and low awareness about early detection. 
• The establishment of Day Care Cancer Centres is a targeted approach to address some of these challenges, especially in semi-urban and rural areas. 
• **Examples of Similar Initiatives:** 
• Countries like **USA and UK** have successfully implemented Day Care Centres for cancer care, ensuring comprehensive treatment and patient comfort. 
• Such centres have proven to be cost-effective and efficient in delivering specialized healthcare services. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Healthcare Budget Allocation:** The Union Budget 2025-26 has prioritized **healthcare and infrastructure development**, reflecting the government's commitment to improve public health services. 
• **Focus on Non-Communicable Diseases:** Cancer and other non-communicable diseases have been a growing concern, prompting government initiatives to address them effectively. 
• **Potential Benefits:** With the establishment of Day Care Cancer Centres, patients can expect **reduced waiting times, better access to treatment**, and improved quality of care. </ul
